```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Preorder β] {f : Finset α → β} : Monotone f ↔ ∀ (s : Finset α) ⦃a : α⦄ (ha : a ∉ s), f s ≤ f (Finset.cons a s ha) := by
  intro h
  split
  · intro s a ha
    rw [Finset.cons_eq_insert]
    exact h _ (Finset.insert_subset.2 ⟨ha, rfl⟩)
  · intro h'
    constructor
    · intros s t hst
      apply h'
      intro a ha
      by_cases h : a ∈ s
      · exact h' _ (Finset.insert_subset.2 (Finset.subset.2 h))
      · exact h' _ (Finset.insert_subset.2 (Finset.subset.1 h))
    · intros s t hst
      apply h'
      intro a ha
      by_cases h : a ∈ s
      · exact h' _ (Finset.insert_subset.2 (Finset.subset.2 h))
      · exact h' _ (Finset.insert_subset.2 (Finset.subset.1 h))
```
